{{Quote|The secret to our mouthwatering nerfsteak is the seasoning: a unique blend of Serrian salt, tertium, punctil and black hole pepper that's been handed down in my family for generations.|From the menu at Dex's Diner|<ref name="Dex's" />}}
'''Serrian salt''' was a kind of [[Salt/Legends|salt]] used by [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef's]] [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. At some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]], Jettster used Serrian salt in his [[Dexter Jettster's nerfsteak seasoning|nerfsteak seasoning]] and in the [[Gartro egg salad]] used for his [[Gartro egg salad sandwich]]es. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], taking something "with a [[Metric ton/Legends|ton]] of Serrian salt" was an idiom in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] used to note the possibility of inaccuracies in a piece of information.

==Description==
Serrian salt was a type of [[Salt/Legends|salt]] that could be used in cooking and making seasonings.<ref name="Dex's" /> Members of the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Species/Legends|species]] were able to [[Diet/Legends|consume]] the salt.<ref name="Besalisk" /> Serrian salt shared its name<ref name="Dex's" /> with the [[Serria system/Legends|Serria system]], a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="TEAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|As he is possibly the biggest and best liar in the entire galaxy, myself excluded, take it with a ton of Serrian salt.|Milo Thirk, using an idiom involving Serrian salt in a report about Lando Calrissian's account of his takeover of Cloud City|<ref name="SWS1">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
[[File:DexterJettster-FF54.png||thumb|right|200px|Dexter Jettser served Serrian salt at his restaurant, Dex's Diner.]]
The Besalisk [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] used Serrian salt at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], his [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="Dex's" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> Jettster used Serrian salt as an ingredient in his [[Dexter Jettster's nerfsteak seasoning|seasoning]] for [[Nerf steak/Legends|nerfsteaks]], a recipe that had been in his [[Dexter Jettster's family|family]] for generations. He also included the salt in the [[Gartro egg salad]] used in his [[Gartro egg salad sandwich]]es.<ref name="Dex's" />

By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], taking something "with a [[Metric ton/Legends|ton]] of Serrian salt" was an idiom in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] that meant to be wary of the truthfulness of a piece of information. At some point after [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] became [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] of [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], [[Milo Thirk]] of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] sent a report about the event to [[Eddriss Sark]] that included the aforementioned phrase to denote the dubious accuracy of Calrissian's account of his takeover of the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony.<ref name="SWS1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Serrian salt was first mentioned in Lando Calrissian's profile in the [[1987]] ''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]'', written by [[Bill Slavicsek]] and [[Curtis Smith]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="SWS1" />
